scope: Coverage and integrity of all 58 collected publications, rechecked after decoration and navigation cleanup. Text-node checks normalize markup, punctuation, entities, and whitespace; exact code and PDF/TXT checks are separate. All prior HTML source anchors remain present. Every PDF page image was decoded and compared with rendered pixels during creation; asset hashes were rechecked after cleanup. Visual inspection was representative. Removed source containers were checked using temporary input backups outside the repository.
